env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A return in a block lambda belongs to the lambda: a tuple literal or a
# tuple variable returned there is forwarded to the results of the
# lambda when it has as many results as the tuple has elements, and it
# stays one tuple value when the lambda has one tuple result. The
# enclosing function has no result, one result or two or three results,
# and the lambda is passed, assigned or a stage of a chain. The module
# runs natively, ejects, and the ejected module builds and runs with go
# and with go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272 and prints the same ok lines.
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_lambda_return.lgo m/main.lgo
cd m
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_lambda_return.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_lambda_return.out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_lambda_return.out
cd ../..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/tuplelambdareturn

go 1.27
